replacement: “Oh, no. Some people have deep feelings and have somehow been crushed. In them, buffoonery is a form of resentful irony toward the people they don’t dare tell the truth to, because for years those people have humiliated and cowed them. Believe me, Krassotkin, that kind of buffoonery can be tragic in the extreme. His whole life now is centered on Ilusha. If Ilusha dies, he will either go mad with grief or kill himself. I’m almost sure of it when I look at him now.”
